title: Managed protocol object
description: The protocol version and the capabilities in force. Sent by an agent in its registration request; sent by the platform in every registration, heartbeat and job answer (or, on an answer without a body, as the Vista-Agent-Protocol header `1; capabilities=a,b`). Version 1 is the only version of this directory: a major version is a new directory (v2/).

capabilities.description: Capability names. Additive: an unknown capability is ignored by both sides. Today: identity_dns_v1, scan_plan_v1, verify_certificate_v1 (sensor); device_discovery (device agent).
